newsitem.title: GERMANY: Jordan's King Hussein visits Germany, meets Kohl.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein visits Germany, meets Kohl.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan arrived in Germany on Monday for a two-day visit expected to focus on bilateral relations and the Middle East peace process.
Chancellor Helmut Kohl welcomed the king at the Bonn chancellery, declaring him "a true friend of our country". The leaders then retired for talks due to last around two hours.
King Hussein was also scheduled to meet Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel, Finance Minister Theo Waigel and Karl-Heinz Hornhues, chairman of the German parliament's foreign affairs committee.
Development Minister Carl-Dieter Spranger was also scheduled to hold talks with the king.

Government officials said there was no formal agenda for the talks but they were expected to include prospects for the Middle East peace process and German-Jordanian ties, described by one official as "largely problem-free".
